links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT-4o on multimodal critical care board questions versus clinicians, and potential harm
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o answered 74.9% correctly vs pooled clinicians 71.1% (p=0.03); image interpretation 61.7%, reasoning 68.3%; 33.3% of responses had potential for clinical harm.
links.quote: Notably, 33.3% of its responses were associated with potential for clinical harm, often due to incorrect image interpretation and treatment recommendations.

links.outcome: Clinical knowledge accuracy and treatment recommendation errors in ChatGPT-4o outputs
links.effect: 33.3% of responses associated with potential for clinical harm, often from incorrect image interpretation and treatment recommendations; reasoning 68.3%, supporting information 66.1%.
links.quote: Notably, 33.3% of its responses were associated with potential for clinical harm, often due to incorrect image interpretation and treatment recommendations.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluation of GPT-4o on multimodal critical care board review questions, assessing accuracy and potential clinical harm without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
